title: Unconditional Architectural Floor for Sycophancy Resistance
summary: Genuine Structural Resistance operates in two tiers: Tier 1 unconditional architectural mechanisms (specialist subagent dispatch for audits, susceptibility snapshot at phase boundaries, research-methods review, mandatory structural output sections) that no context relaxes, and Tier 2 context-responsive conversational mechanisms calibrated by phase vulnerability, engagement quality, and content trajectory.

links.note: ADR-100 names in-context pre-triage as a Tier 2 mechanism and makes the isolated snapshot (Tier 1) the reader of its triage record
